python -c "
from glom import Auto, Fill, Invoke, Iter, Let, ROOT, Merge, merge, T

# Test Merge spec and merge function
result = merge([{'a': 1}, {'b': 2}])
assert result == {'a': 1, 'b': 2}, f'merge failed: {result}'
print('merge OK:', result)

# Test dynamic key with Spec
from glom import glom, Spec
target = {'x': 10, 'y': 20}
spec = {Spec('x'): T, Spec('y'): 'name'}
result = glom(target, spec)
print('Dynamic keys:', result)

# Test python-full CLI spec
import subprocess
r = subprocess.run(['python', '-m', 'glom', '--spec-format', 'python-full', '{\"result\": T[\"x\"] * 2}', '{\"x\": 5}'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print('CLI python-full spec:', r.stdout.strip())

# Test python-full target
r = subprocess.run(['python', '-m', 'glom', '--target-format', 'python-full', \"T['x']\", '{\"x\": 42}'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print('CLI python-full target:', r.stdout.strip())
" 2>&1
